# SoDak Services

> Locally owned lawn care and landscaping company in Sioux Falls, South Dakota, run by Anthony Erickson and Preston Ver Steeg, mowing since 2021.

- Services: weekly lawn mowing, one-time mowing, landscaping, and spring and fall yard cleanups
- Service area: Sioux Falls, Harrisburg, Tea and Brandon, SD
- Pricing: lawn mowing starts at $45 per visit. Larger or more demanding yards cost more; request a property-specific quote.
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 7 AM to 7 PM; Sunday closed
- Free quotes: call or text (605) 254-0988, email servicessodak@gmail.com, or use the form at https://www.sodakservices.com/contact/
